import os, json, re, datetime, time, requests, sys

def get_next_epoch(hour, minute=0, tz_offset=-3):
    now_utc = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    now_local = now_utc + datetime.timedelta(hours=tz_offset)
    target = now_local.replace(hour=hour, minute=minute, second=0, microsecond=0)
    if target <= now_local:
        target += datetime.timedelta(days=1)
    return int((target - datetime.timedelta(hours=tz_offset)).timestamp())
